card.name: Start of contraindication list items
card.fires_on: Words that open an item in a contraindications list, such as a, known, active, with or acute, right before a condition or allergy. Also list punctuation between such items.

modes.label: Allergy opener
modes.description: Small word before a known allergy or hypersensitivity in a contraindications statement.

modes.label: Next list item
modes.description: Opening word or punctuation of a new item in a list of contraindicated conditions.

card.writes: It pushes toward pregnancy-related words (pregnant, pregnancy) as the next contraindication, and away from unrelated tokens.
card.plain: It marks the spot in a contraindications list where the next condition, often pregnancy, is about to be named.
